valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 84.21 percent a year from FY2021 (3.183e+07) to FY2025 (3.6655e+08), over 4 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2024
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 2.67997e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (Yahoo Finance; price 1.42 EGP)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 2.67997e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (Yahoo Finance; price 1.42 EGP)

models.accrualsReading: high - profit is not arriving as cash

flags.label: Persistently weak cash conversion
flags.detail: Operating cash flow has been under 80% of net profit for 2 straight periods (latest -0.67x).

flags.label: Thin interest cover
flags.detail: EBIT covers finance costs only 1.67x in FY2025.

derived.enterpriseValueBasis: market cap + borrowings - cash, both from the balance sheet for FY2024
derived.ytdBasis: year to date from the last close before 2026 (2025-12-31, 1.77) to the price on 2026-10-05
